verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a built-in infrastructure agent. Its docs say you can tell Neo what you need in plain English and it handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes, and they explicitly describe delegating infrastructure work to Pulumi Agents/Neo, including from external assistants via the MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Neo's delegation in practice, in-depth first-party docs on task scope and approval/oversight workflow (current evidence is mostly product-page claims).
